**Table 1. Static Analysis of Volumetric Payload Optimization and Compression Ratio**

| Metric ID | Firmware Full Binary Version Pair Size (Bytes) | Delta Patch Size (Bytes) | Total Bytes Saved | Compression Ratio (%) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| VOL_01 | v1.0 to v1.1: 288,880 | 22,497 | 266,383 | 92.21 |

**How to read it.** One static benchmark of the version pair, as the approved volume states (1 per version pair). "Firmware Full Binary" is the raw v1.1 image;
"Delta Patch" is the bsdiff4 engine output (BSDIFF40), not the device stream. Total Bytes Saved = 288,880 - 22,497 = 266,383.
Compression Ratio = 266,383 / 288,880 x 100 = **92.21%** (Equation 3 with the full image as the baseline).
The bytes on the wire measured in Scenarios A and B (86.13% fewer) are reported with Table 2, not here.
